thesis: Operationally Merck benefits from its patent-protected oncology franchise and global vaccine manufacturing. Unit economics are strong at the reported margins; the main operating exposure is loss of exclusivity on its largest oncology product later in the decade.
invalidation_rationale: Evidence of supply disruption or sustained share loss would undermine the moat.
conviction_reason: Structural advantages are documented in filings.
self_evidence_reason: Business description and MD&A reviewed; no independent volume data.

sources.title: Annual reports (10-K) — MRK (SEC EDGAR filing index)
Quarterly reports (10-Q) — MRK (SEC EDGAR filing index)
Current reports (8-K) — MRK (SEC EDGAR filing index)

supply_chain.assessment: Manufacturing is concentrated in a few qualified sites with dual sourcing for critical inputs.

capacity_backlog.assessment: Capacity additions are disclosed in the annual report; no backlog metric applies to most products.

execution.assessment: Launch cadence and integration of acquired assets have been on plan per recent quarterly reports.

unit_economics.assessment: Reported gross and operating margins show high incremental returns on established products.

operational_moat.assessment: The patent-protected oncology franchise and global vaccine manufacturing is hard to replicate quickly.
